description: This file defines the QuerySerializer class responsible for serializing AWS query protocol requests. It constructs HTTP requests with appropriate headers, body, and endpoint details based on AWS commands.

classes.name: QuerySerializer
classes.description: A class that serializes AWS API requests following the query protocol, constructing HTTP requests with proper parameters and headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serializer with the service API, endpoint, and optional parameter builder.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a command into an HTTP request, setting method, URI, headers, and body based on the command's details.
